en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a quiet residential street lined with early 20th‑century multi‑storey houses featuring steep tiled gable roofs, stucco facades, bay windows and balconies decorated with flower boxes. Wooden picket fences border small front gardens. Several utility poles with multiple crossbars run along the street. Children and a few adults stand or play in the unpaved roadway. In the background a larger institutional or residential building closes the vista. The overall scene has a Central European, pre‑World War II atmosphere.
